mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome to this journey, where tradition and modern life meet head-on in the search for what authentic faith really looks like. Have you ever wondered how ancient scriptures can shape the choices we make today—especially when it comes to the roles and expectations placed on women? Together, we're going to explore these questions through the honest, sometimes hilarious, and always thought-provoking lens of Rachel Held Evans in her book, A Year of Biblical Womanhood. Rachel dives right into the complexities of womanhood, using scripture as her guide but never shying away from the contradictions and cultural twists that come with it. You'll find yourself reflecting on what it means to live out faith in a way that's both true to ancient wisdom and honest about our modern realities. As each month unfolds, every new challenge and ritual becomes an invitation to walk in the shoes of women from different times and places. We’ll see how obedience and grace can look different for each of us, and how honoring faith doesn’t mean losing our individuality. This isn’t about finding all the right answers—it’s about asking the hard questions and letting humor, courage, and vulnerability light the way. So, if you’re ready to take a closer look at identity, spirituality, and what it means to live biblically in today’s world, you’re in the right place. Let’s step into this conversation together and discover what unfolds.
